speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain for the past three weeks. To begin my assessment, are you currently a child or an adolescent, and how would you describe the severity of the pain in your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (specifically Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia). The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia until proven otherwise. Immediate blood work including a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Peripheral Smear is required to confirm the diagnosis.
